name: vike-actions
description: vike-actions: named, guarded server actions referenced from serializable config. A vike-blocks button/form carries an action NAME (never a closure); this resolves the name to a handler, authorizes it (compose vike-rbac / the owner contract), validates its input, and runs it behind one POST /_actions/<name> endpoint. Per-framework client bindings (vike-actions/react, /vue) are a fast-follow.
